svg.title: Esophageal dysphagia decision chart: solids only points to a mechanical cause (ring, web or stricture, eosinophilic esophagitis, cancer), solids and liquids to a motility disorder (achalasia, distal esophageal spasm or jackhammer, scleroderma esophagus); each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment

svg.text: Food sticks SECONDS after the swallow, behind the sternum: SOLIDS only, or SOLIDS + LIQUIDS?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: can't START the swallow, coughing, choking, nasal regurgitation → OROPHARYNGEAL, not this chart

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ask: where it sticks · progressive or intermittent · heartburn · weight loss, hematemesis, anemia

svg.text: • endoscopy: sees the tissue + biopsy (invasive, perforation risk)

svg.text: • barium swallow: easy, shows function, not tissue
